title: BountyRadar MCP output
description: This Actor is a remote MCP server: it does not write results to the default dataset. All output is delivered synchronously to MCP clients over the Streamable HTTP endpoint listed below. Tools: get_bounty_feed, search_bounties, get_bounty_detail, score_bounty, list_sources, get_stats, subscribe_feed.

mcpEndpoint.title: MCP endpoint
mcpEndpoint.description: Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint of this Actor run. Connect an MCP client here (Authorization: Bearer <APIFY_TOKEN>). POST JSON-RPC messages: initialize, tools/list, tools/call.
